key_finding: Future media does not predict current ODA: γ = 0.048, p = 0.144.
Generic country coverage does not predict ODA (β = -0.019, p = 0.556); same across all 7 temporal headlines.
The association remains positive for roughly three years, peaking contemporaneously before fading in year four.

The emergency−non-emergency difference is concentrated in the contemporaneous window (β = 0.674, p < 0.001); lagged-window, rolling-average and streak differences are not consistently significant (streak ≥ 60: β = 0.663, p = 0.058).
No sign reversals in any analysis. Only the roll60 estimate shows six significance-status changes (6/140).
Top-1% trim of emergency commitments: β = 0.523, p = 0.007. A log(x+1) OLS counterpart does not reproduce the difference (β = 0.006, p = 0.864).
All 6 crisis types are individually positive and significant (p < 0.05); joint test: χ²(6) = 28.057, p < 0.001.
